Accomplishments for This Reporting Perio.guidance: List all work packages or other accomplishments completed.

Accomplishments Planned but Not Complete.guidance: Work that was scheduled but delayed.

Root Cause of Variances.guidance: Identify the root cause of schedule or work variances.

Impact to Upcoming Milestones or Due Dat.guidance: Identify any impact to critical path or future milestones.

Planned Corrective or Preventive Action.guidance: Actions to recover schedule or prevent delays.

Root Cause of Cost Variances.guidance: Identify causes for any budget overruns or underruns.

Impact to Overall Budget or Contingency.guidance: How the cost variance affects the total budget.

Quality Variances Identified.guidance: Identify any product performance or quality issues.

Accomplishments Planned for Next Period.guidance: Work scheduled for the upcoming period.

Costs Planned for Next Period.guidance: Expected expenditures for the upcoming period.

New Risks Identified.guidance: New risks that should be added to the risk register.

Issues.guidance: New issues that should be added to the issue log.
